metadata.description: Enterprise AI spec-driven development (SDD) framework: core plugin plus pluggable stack and domain packs.

plugins.name: sdd-core
plugins.description: Enterprise core: agents, workflows, gates, guardrail hooks, standards, templates. Mandatory for every SDD project.

plugins.name: ea-baseline
plugins.description: Enterprise Architecture baseline ADRs, reference decisions and approved pack catalog. Mandatory alongside sdd-core.

plugins.name: pack-template
plugins.description: Starter for building a new stack or domain pack. Copy, rename, fill the slots.

plugins.name: pack-java-ejb-legacy
plugins.description: Source pack: analysis and semantic parity for Java 8 / EJB 3.x / JSF / JPA / Oracle monoliths.

plugins.name: pack-nodejs-lambda
plugins.description: Target pack: Node.js + TypeScript services on AWS Lambda with Oracle, Entra ID, observability.
